+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING SLICE — the formatter's pretty-printing ENGINE, written in Rian
+# ===========================================================================
+# A Rian port of `Rian.Format.Doc` (the Wadler/Lindig strict pretty-printer that
+# drives line wrapping; ADR-0045). The Doc algebra + the linear worklist renderer
+# are pure recursion over lists/strings/ints — squarely in the self-hostable
+# subset — so they are the cleanest first slice of the formatter to bring into
+# Rian. Fixpoint-locked against `Rian.Format.Doc.render/2` in
+# `test/rian/format_doc_fixpoint_test.exs`: both engines build the same Doc from a
+# shared recipe (via these `pub` constructors) and must render byte-identical
+# output over a corpus.
+#
+# NOT yet ported (the remaining tail, BEAM-only by design): the trivia lexer, the
+# bracket CST, and the line/indent + chain-wrap lowering — they lean on the host
+# lexer and richer collections. See ADR-0045 / SELFHOST.md.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod RianFormatDoc do
+  # render mode: a group is laid out flat (one line) or broken (with newlines)
+  type Mode := MFlat | MBreak
+
+  # the document algebra (mirrors Rian.Format.Doc):
+  #   DLine(s) is a break that becomes `s` when flat (" " = line, "" = softline);
+  #   DGroup(must_break, d) caches break-propagation; DIfBreak(b, f) picks by mode.
+  type Doc :=
+      DEmpty
+    | DText(String)
+    | DConcat(Vec(Doc))
+    | DNest(Int53, Doc)
+    | DLine(String)
+    | DHard
+    | DGroup(Bool, Doc)
+    | DSuffix(Doc)
+    | DIfBreak(Doc, Doc)
+
+  # a worklist entry: indentation, mode, document
+  type Item := It(Int53, Mode, Doc)
+
+  # ── public constructors (both engines build from the same recipe) ─────────
+  pub def dempty() Doc := DEmpty
+  pub def dtext(s String) Doc := DText(s)
+  pub def dconcat(ds Vec(Doc)) Doc := DConcat(ds)
+  pub def dnest(n Int53, d Doc) Doc := DNest(n, d)
+  pub def dline() Doc := DLine(" ")
+  pub def dsoft() Doc := DLine("")
+  pub def dhard() Doc := DHard
+  pub def dsuffix(d Doc) Doc := DSuffix(d)
+  pub def dif_break(b Doc, f Doc) Doc := DIfBreak(b, f)
+
+  # group: caches whether it must break (contains a hard break, propagated up)
+  pub def dgroup(d Doc) Doc := DGroup(has_hard(d), d)
+  pub def dgroup_forced(d Doc) Doc := DGroup(true, d)
+
+  # ── break propagation (Prettier's propagateBreaks) ────────────────────────
+  def has_hard(Doc) Bool
+  def has_hard(DEmpty) := false
+  def has_hard(DText(_)) := false
+  def has_hard(DLine(_)) := false
+  def has_hard(DHard) := true
+  def has_hard(DConcat(ds)) := has_hard_list(ds)
+  def has_hard(DNest(_, d)) := has_hard(d)
+  def has_hard(DGroup(mb, _)) := mb
+  def has_hard(DSuffix(d)) := has_hard(d)
+  def has_hard(DIfBreak(b, f))
+    if has_hard(b) do
+      true
+    else
+      has_hard(f)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def has_hard_list(Vec(Doc)) Bool
+  def has_hard_list([]) := false
+  def has_hard_list([d | ds])
+    if has_hard(d) do
+      true
+    else
+      has_hard_list(ds)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # ── small string helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  def vlen(Vec(Int53)) Int53
+  def vlen([]) := 0
+  def vlen([_ | rest]) := 1 + vlen(rest)
+
+  def slen(s String) Int53 := vlen(Prim.str_chars(s))
+
+  def spaces(n Int53) String
+  def spaces(n)
+    if n <= 0 do
+      ""
+    else
+      " " <> spaces(n - 1)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_doc(Vec(Doc), Vec(Doc)) Vec(Doc)
+  def rev_doc([], acc) := acc
+  def rev_doc([d | ds], acc) := rev_doc(ds, [d | acc])
+
+  # expand a concat's children onto the front of the worklist with shared (i, m)
+  def items(Int53, Mode, Vec(Doc), Vec(Item)) Vec(Item)
+  def items(_i, _m, [], rest) := rest
+  def items(i, m, [d | ds], rest) := [It(i, m, d) | items(i, m, ds, rest)]
+
+  # ── fits?: can the worklist render flat within `w` columns? (Lindig) ──────
+  def fits(Int53, Vec(Item)) Bool
+  def fits(w, _work) when w < 0 := false
+  def fits(_w, []) := true
+  def fits(w, [It(_, _, DEmpty) | rest]) := fits(w, rest)
+  def fits(w, [It(_, _, DText(s)) | rest]) := fits(w - slen(s), rest)
+  def fits(w, [It(i, m, DConcat(ds)) | rest]) := fits(w, items(i, m, ds, rest))
+  def fits(w, [It(i, m, DNest(n, d)) | rest]) := fits(w, [It(i + n, m, d) | rest])
+  def fits(_w, [It(_, MBreak, DLine(_)) | _rest]) := true
+  def fits(w, [It(_, MFlat, DLine(s)) | rest]) := fits(w - slen(s), rest)
+  def fits(_w, [It(_, _, DHard) | _rest]) := true
+  def fits(w, [It(_, _, DSuffix(_)) | rest]) := fits(w, rest)
+  def fits(w, [It(i, MFlat, DIfBreak(_, f)) | rest]) := fits(w, [It(i, MFlat, f) | rest])
+  def fits(w, [It(i, MBreak, DIfBreak(b, _)) | rest]) := fits(w, [It(i, MBreak, b) | rest])
+  def fits(w, [It(i, _, DGroup(mb, d)) | rest])
+    if mb do
+      fits(w, [It(i, MBreak, d) | rest])
+    else
+      fits(w, [It(i, MFlat, d) | rest])
+    end
+  end
+
+  # ── render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  pub def render(d Doc, w Int53) String := go(w, 0, [It(0, MBreak, d)], [], "")
+
+  # go(width, column, worklist, deferred-suffixes, output)
+  def go(Int53, Int53, Vec(Item), Vec(Doc), String) String
+  def go(_w, _k, [], suffix, out) := flush(suffix, out)
+  def go(w, k, [It(_, _, DEmpty) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, k, rest, suffix, out)
+  def go(w, k, [It(_, _, DText(s)) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, k + slen(s), rest, suffix, out <> s)
+  def go(w, k, [It(i, m, DConcat(ds)) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, k, items(i, m, ds, rest), suffix, out)
+  def go(w, k, [It(i, m, DNest(n, d)) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, k, [It(i + n, m, d) | rest], suffix, out)
+  def go(w, k, [It(_, MFlat, DLine(s)) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, k + slen(s), rest, suffix, out <> s)
+  def go(w, _k, [It(i, MBreak, DLine(_)) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, i, rest, [], flush(suffix, out) <> "\n" <> spaces(i))
+  def go(w, _k, [It(i, _, DHard) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, i, rest, [], flush(suffix, out) <> "\n" <> spaces(i))
+  def go(w, k, [It(_, _, DSuffix(d)) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, k, rest, [d | suffix], out)
+  def go(w, k, [It(i, MFlat, DIfBreak(_, f)) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, k, [It(i, MFlat, f) | rest], suffix, out)
+  def go(w, k, [It(i, MBreak, DIfBreak(b, _)) | rest], suffix, out) := go(w, k, [It(i, MBreak, b) | rest], suffix, out)
+  def go(w, k, [It(i, _, DGroup(mb, d)) | rest], suffix, out)
+    if not mb and fits(w - k, [It(i, MFlat, d) | rest]) do
+      go(w, k, [It(i, MFlat, d) | rest], suffix, out)
+    else
+      go(w, k, [It(i, MBreak, d) | rest], suffix, out)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # flush deferred suffix docs (insertion order) onto the output before a newline
+  def flush(Vec(Doc), String) String
+  def flush(suffix, out) := flush_go(rev_doc(suffix, []), out)
+
+  def flush_go(Vec(Doc), String) String
+  def flush_go([], out) := out
+  def flush_go([d | ds], out) := flush_go(ds, out <> flat(d))
+
+  # render a doc with no line breaks (suffix content is always flat)
+  def flat(Doc) String
+  def flat(DEmpty) := ""
+  def flat(DText(s)) := s
+  def flat(DConcat(ds)) := flat_list(ds)
+  def flat(DNest(_, d)) := flat(d)
+  def flat(DGroup(_, d)) := flat(d)
+  def flat(DLine(s)) := s
+  def flat(DHard) := ""
+  def flat(DSuffix(d)) := flat(d)
+  def flat(DIfBreak(_, f)) := flat(f)
+
+  def flat_list(Vec(Doc)) String
+  def flat_list([]) := ""
+  def flat_list([d | ds]) := flat(d) <> flat_list(ds)
+end

+defmodule Rian.FormatDocFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — loads a real module into the VM via :code.load_binary.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.Beam
+  alias Rian.Format.Doc
+
+  # Self-hosting fixpoint for the formatter's pretty-printing **engine** (ADR-0045):
+  # a Rian port of `Rian.Format.Doc` (compiler/format.rian), compiled to real `.beam`,
+  # its `render/2` **diffed against the reference `Rian.Format.Doc.render/2`**. Both
+  # engines build the *same* document from a shared recipe (via each side's
+  # constructors, so break-propagation is each engine's own) and must render
+  # byte-identical output across a range of widths — turning the ported engine into a
+  # regression test, not a demo.
+
+  setup_all do
+    {:ok, mod} = Beam.load(File.read!("compiler/format.rian"), :rian_format_doc_fixpoint)
+    {:ok, mod: mod}
+  end
+
+  # A "builder" is a map of constructor closures, so one recipe drives both engines.
+  defp rian_b(mod) do
+    %{
+      empty: &mod.dempty/0,
+      text: &mod.dtext/1,
+      concat: &mod.dconcat/1,
+      nest: &mod.dnest/2,
+      line: &mod.dline/0,
+      soft: &mod.dsoft/0,
+      hard: &mod.dhard/0,
+      group: &mod.dgroup/1,
+      group_f: &mod.dgroup_forced/1,
+      suffix: &mod.dsuffix/1,
+      if_break: &mod.dif_break/2,
+      render: &mod.render/2
+    }
+  end
+
+  defp ex_b do
+    %{
+      empty: fn -> Doc.empty() end,
+      text: &Doc.text/1,
+      concat: &Doc.concat/1,
+      nest: &Doc.nest/2,
+      line: &Doc.line/0,
+      soft: &Doc.softline/0,
+      hard: &Doc.hardline/0,
+      group: &Doc.group/1,
+      group_f: &Doc.group(&1, true),
+      suffix: &Doc.line_suffix/1,
+      if_break: &Doc.if_break/2,
+      render: &Doc.render/2
+    }
+  end
+
+  # ── recipes (one shape per clause; `b` is the builder) ────────────────────
+  defp recipe("plain text", b), do: b.text.("hello world")
+  defp recipe("concat + nest", b), do: b.concat.([b.text.("a"), b.nest.(2, b.text.("b"))])
+  defp recipe("call group", b), do: call(b, ["alpha", "beta", "gamma"])
+  defp recipe("single-arg call", b), do: call(b, ["x"])
+  defp recipe("empty group", b), do: b.group.(b.concat.([b.text.("("), b.text.(")")]))
+
+  defp recipe("nested calls", b) do
+    b.group.(
+      b.concat.([
+        b.text.("outer("),
+        b.nest.(
+          2,
+          b.concat.([b.soft.(), call(b, ["aa", "bb"]), b.text.(","), b.line.(), call(b, ["cc", "dd"])])
+        ),
+        b.soft.(),
+        b.text.(")")
+      ])
+    )
+  end
+
+  defp recipe("hardline forces break", b) do
+    b.group.(
+      b.concat.([
+        b.text.("do"),
+        b.nest.(2, b.concat.([b.hard.(), b.text.("s")])),
+        b.hard.(),
+        b.text.("end")
+      ])
+    )
+  end
+
+  defp recipe("line_suffix comment", b) do
+    b.concat.([b.text.("x"), b.suffix.(b.text.("  # c")), b.hard.(), b.text.("y")])
+  end
+
+  defp recipe("forced group (magic comma)", b), do: b.group_f.(call_inner(b, ["p", "q"]))
+
+  defp recipe("if_break only", b) do
+    b.group.(
+      b.concat.([
+        b.text.("["),
+        b.nest.(2, b.concat.([b.soft.(), b.text.("1")])),
+        b.if_break.(b.text.(","), b.empty.()),
+        b.soft.(),
+        b.text.("]")
+      ])
+    )
+  end
+
+  @recipe_names [
+    "plain text",
+    "concat + nest",
+    "call group",
+    "single-arg call",
+    "empty group",
+    "nested calls",
+    "hardline forces break",
+    "line_suffix comment",
+    "forced group (magic comma)",
+    "if_break only"
+  ]
+
+  # comma+line separated items wrapped in a 2-space nested group: `f(a, b, c)`
+  defp call(b, args), do: b.group.(call_inner_named(b, "f(", args))
+  defp call_inner(b, args), do: call_inner_named(b, "g(", args)
+
+  defp call_inner_named(b, open, args) do
+    items =
+      args
+      |> Enum.map(&b.text.(&1))
+      |> Enum.intersperse(b.concat.([b.text.(","), b.line.()]))
+      |> b.concat.()
+
+    b.concat.([
+      b.text.(open),
+      b.nest.(2, b.concat.([b.soft.(), items])),
+      b.if_break.(b.text.(","), b.empty.()),
+      b.soft.(),
+      b.text.(")")
+    ])
+  end
+
+  @widths [2, 4, 8, 16, 40, 80]
+
+  for name <- @recipe_names do
+    @name name
+    test "the ported engine renders #{name} identically to Rian.Format.Doc", %{mod: mod} do
+      rian_doc = recipe(@name, rian_b(mod))
+      ex_doc = recipe(@name, ex_b())
+
+      for w <- @widths do
+        assert mod.render(rian_doc, w) == Doc.render(ex_doc, w),
+               "diverged on #{@name} at width #{w}"
+      end
+    end
+  end
+end
